compatibility_matrix.resolution: V3 retains the V2 PlainProof layout; raw Merkle roots remain on wire and cert_version remains in MiningJob.
V3 has the V2 variable-public-data certificate layout, selected by an on-wire u32 version.
The commitment domain is SHA256d(cert_version_le32 || public_data); V3 uses prefix 3, not the V2 prefix.
No V3 arithmetic change was found; current template target remains immutable job state.
Mainnet SaltedSeedForkHeight is 99000, but the miner trusts requiredcertversion/cert_version from the live template rather than inferring height.
The official V1.4.2 node requires minimum peer protocol version 2; read-only mainnet preparation verifies connected peers report version 2.
This custom miner's verified execution path is dense-only; no MoE route is claimed or implemented.
